name: Fashion & Couture
purpose: Provide a business-aware design and engineering system for couture houses, bespoke tailors, fashion ateliers, occasion wear, corporate tailoring, traditional wear and made-to-order fashion brands.
productPrinciple: The garment, craftsmanship, fit, material quality and enquiry/order path are the product. Visual prestige must support evidence and conversion rather than replace them.
primaryJourneys: enquire, book or order through a verified channel
requiredCapabilities: owner-confirmation handling for unverified operational facts
rejectConditions: design selection before business-profile status is ready
generic luxury visuals unrelated to garments, tailoring, culture or materials
generated people or garments presented as official client work
fashion imagery that obscures product fit or construction
invented prices, turnaround times, delivery coverage, measurements or fabric claims
motion that prevents garment inspection or enquiry
another fashion brand cloned in layout, copy, imagery or choreography
